page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with a running head at the top right. The column is set in small type, with italic lead words for each entry. No margins carry text. The page continues in part 2.; One column of index text: entries in lines of alphabetical references, then the letter E and a paragraph of entries beginning with a drop cap, ending with a catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: Crucifixio Christi facta An. Ær. Vulg. 33. die 3 Aprilis. p. 213. &c.

Dies nati Christi ex traditione Romana 25 Decembris alligatus apud gentiles fuit dies solis invicti p. 13-16. Assentientibus Petavio, Pagio & Harduino. p. 15. Traditio illa Clementis Alexandrini tempore nondum cognita. p. 30. Invaluit demum Ambrosii ætate. p. 28. Ex falso calculo minus [?] solidè adstructa. p. 25. Refutatur ex tempestate hybernâ, characteribus euangelicis non consentiente. p. 32-36.
Verus tantum ante diem emortualem Herodis statuendus, quantum temporis sibi postulant Magorum mora in Judæâ & exilium Jesu Ægyptiacum, simul sumpta. p. 136.
Mortis Herodis cum ultimo exilii Christi Ægyptiaci concurrit. p. 130. 131. In diem vii mensis Cisleu incidit. p. 121-126. quantum temporis post natum Christum vixerit? p. 133. 134.
——— Purificationis Mariæ fuit 41 à nato Christo [?]p. 136. 137. ponendus post Magorum adventum & post fugam in

page.notes: Part 1 of 2; the lower part of the page is cut off and is not transcribed. Uncertain readings: "minus" in "Ex falso calculo minus" is read as "minis" and marked [?]. The symbol after "Christo" in the Purificationis entry is not clearly legible and is marked [?]. The dash before "Purificationis" is printed as a rule. The catchword "vocay-" at the foot and the page number "99" in the E entry are doubtful readings. The initial letters of the top index entries are clear.
